# Balance Pill
English | 简体中文

A small, always-visible readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer dock: the
signed-in account's walle

t balance and how much the wallet has dropped since
the current session started.
> Unofficial community plugin. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.
## Preview

A text sketch of the composer dock. The live pill follows the active theme and
locale.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The pill is one tabbable button: click to refresh, hover for the breakdown and
the start time of the

tabbable button: click to refresh, hover for the breakdown and
the start time of the session total.
## What it shows
| Reading | Meaning |

| **Balance** | Recharged wallet plus granted/bonus wallet, folded into one currency. |
| **This ses
sion** | Sum of wallet decreases observed since this session's first reading. |

- Hover the pill for the recharge/granted breakdown, the last update time, and
when counting started

.
- Click the pill to refresh immediately.
- The pill also refreshes every 60 seconds, when the wind

ow regains focus, and
shortly after each completed turn. Two automatic readings are at least 15
seco

nds apart. Repeated failures back off at 120 s → 240 s → 300 s (capped).
- The last successful readi

ng is reused for the first paint after a page
reload, so the dock does not flash an empty value.
## Install
Requirements:

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop or Web, `0.2.1-rc.2` through `0.2.x`.
- A signed-in DeepSeek account (the

plugin reads the same wallet the account
menu shows).
- The `deepseekAccount` Host service. It ship

s with the desktop account stack;
a headless composition without that service reports `account-unava

he desktop account stack;
a headless composition without that service reports `account-unavailable`.
Pick one source.
### From npm

by the `jayve-dev` npm account. The package is unscoped, so the inst

all path is
just the package name.

After installation, restart the Harness process (Host code changes need a

eload), then reload the Web page. Verify that the

Look for a `# == dsh-balance-pill` layer and a `balance-pill` row. If the plugin

ill is missing, see Troubleshooting.
### Uninstall

### Migrating from a local build

If a development row such as `@local/dsh-balance-meter` is still active, remove
that bundle before a

dding this one. The two pills would otherwise render side
by side; the new row id is `balance-pill`,

so no config row collides, but the
dock entry and polling would be duplicated.
## How it works
The plugin has two halves:

1. **Client** — mounts one entry into the `conversation.composer.dock` slot,
polls a local JSON rout

e, and keeps the per-session running total in
`localStorage`.
2. **Host** — serves `GET /dsh-balance

-pill/state` on the Harness Web server.
It asks the Host account service for the current wallet and

returns only the
aggregated amounts.

The browser never calls the account Remote namespace and never sees a token,
an account id, or a Pla

tform request header. This split exists because the
account Remote call that works on the Host can f

ail from the desktop renderer;
the local route is the stable path across Web and Desktop builds.
### Route
`GET /dsh-balance-pill/state?locale=<ui locale>&tz=<offset seconds>`

The route accepts only loopback peers, a loopback `Host` authority, and only
`GET`. Responses are `C
ache-Control: no-store`.
| Status | Body | Meaning |
| `200` | `{"ok":true,"status":"ready","currency":"CNY","recharged":6.19,"granted":0,"total":6.19}`

| Wallet read succeeded. |
| `200` | `{"ok":true,"status":"signed-out"}` | No stored DeepSeek creden

tial. |
| `200` | `{"ok":true,"status":"failed"}` | The Platform balance query failed. |
| `403` | `

{"ok":false,"error":"loopback-only"}` | Non-loopback peer. |
| `403` | `{"ok":false,"error":"host-no

t-allowed"}` | `Host` is not `127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, or `[::1]`. |
| `405` | `{"ok":false,"error":

"method-not-allowed"}` + `Allow: GET` | Wrong method. |
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy and security

- The route is bound to the Harness Web server and rejects non-loopback peers.
- The `Host` header m

ust name a loopback authority (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`,
or `[::1]`). A public hostname that resolve

s to loopback is refused, which
closes the DNS-rebinding path to this route.
- The route has **no ad

ditional authentication**, like the other local
plugin routes. Any process on the same machine can r

ead the balance number.
The response contains only currency amounts; it carries no account id,
profi

le, token, or transaction list.
- The Client stores only the last summary and the per-session ledger

in
`localStorage`, on the Harness origin. It contains no credentials.
- The plugin sends no telemet

ry. The only network request is the Host account
service call to the configured DeepSeek Platform or

igin, the same one the
account menu performs.
- The browser bundle adds no remote content and no `ev

, the same one the
account menu performs.
- The browser bundle adds no remote content and no `eval`.
## Compatibility
| Component | Supported |

| DeepSeek Harness | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (declared as `engines.dsh`) |
| Surfaces | Desktop Web GU

I; CLI `web` profile |
| Account service | `deepseekAccount` (DeepSeek account login) |
| Node (deve

The manifest declares `engines.dsh`, so an incompatible Harness release refuses
the bundle instead o

f loading it half-way. Removing that field is not a
supported workaround; open an issue with the Har
ness version instead.
